newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo state issues Comgas bid specs draft.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo state issues Comgas bid specs draft.

text.p: Sao Paulo state government said it has released a draft of the bid specifications to hire consultants to advise on the sale of its gas firm Comgas and concessions to distribute gas in the state.
The state will hold a public hearing on Jan 22 to discuss the bid specifications with interested investors and consultants.

The final version of the document is expected to be published by mid-February, said Ricardo Lima, an official at the Sao Paulo energy department who advises investors on the state's privatization plan.
He also said 31 firms already got the bid specifications draft.
The state plans to hire two consultants. One will be responsible for making a financial evaluation of Comgas and set a minimum price for the firm.
The second consultant will be in charge of making a financial and economic analysis of the firm and also design a privization model for Comgas, Lima said.
Comgas, which is responsible for 30 percent of Brazil natural gas sales, is expected to privatized in October, he added.
